outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially lowered and open (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the door, then raises it toward the oven front (frames 50–64, image and left_ego_image). The door is upright and closed by frame 66 and remains closed through frame 84 (image and left_ego_image, with a close view in wrist_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
